annotations.title: Price history of a VPS host

description: Use for «did X raise prices», «when did Y get cheaper». Price changes of one host's plans over the last 1-60 days, newest first: plan, date, old and new monthly price in the host's own currency and in the locale currency, change in per cent. Only real price moves by the host; corrections of misread prices are left out. The history starts on 2026-11-14.

host.description: Host slug from other results (e.g. "aeza", "timeweb-cloud"), its domain ("hetzner.com") or exact name.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.

plan.description: Only plans whose name contains these words, e.g. "CX22".

name: price_history
